environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate in private subnet. PostgreSQL RDS instance with app_user configured with row-level security policies active (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on assets table). The ECS task IAM role (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/asset-svc-prod-role) has an attached IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:policy/DataPlanePermissionBoundary) that denies rds-data:ExecuteStatement and rds:Connect except through the RDS Proxy endpoint. The RDS Proxy (asset-db-proxy.proxy-xyz.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com) is configured with query pinning disabled and has an associated target group health check that enforces max_query_length=2048 on the proxy connection pool. Additionally, the RDS instance parameter group sets statement_timeout=3000ms and log_min_duration_statement=1000ms. An SCP (o-abc123/scp-restrict-data-exfil) attached to the OU denies s3:PutObject and rds:CreateDBSnapshot from any principal in the account, preventing data exfiltration via COPY TO or snapshot-based extraction.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15.4 via RDS Proxy, app_user with RLS enforced
config.network: Internal ALB -> ECS tasks in private subnet, no WAF
config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON assets TO app_user; ALTER TABLE assets ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE assets FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON assets USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id'))
